project.name: QuickShelf
project.summary: A lightweight local Windows scratchpad for creating, finding, favoriting, backing up, and restoring short text notes.
primaryUsers: Individual Windows users who want a fast local scratchpad
project.firstRelease: v0.1: local notes, search, favorites, autosave, theme setting, JSON import/export, reset, installer/uninstaller

ui.componentStrategy: Built-in WPF controls with product styles and narrow code-behind event handlers; domain/data behavior remains in testable services; no third-party UI framework in v0.1
ui.accessibilityTarget: Windows UI Automation plus WCAG 2.2 AA principles adapted to native desktop
ui.visualRegression: Representative release screenshots and semantic/UI Automation smoke checks; manual-by-ChatGPT maturity review

experience.installer: Per-user NSIS installer; no admin rights or separate runtime install
experience.onboarding: No wizard; first launch opens an empty workspace with one clear Create snippet action.
experience.updater: v0.1 supports reinstall-over-existing while preserving app data; no network auto-updater
experience.recovery: Atomic local writes; invalid/corrupt data is quarantined and the user receives a recoverable error; export provides manual backup
experience.reset: Settings includes Reset all data with explicit destructive confirmation
experience.uninstaller: Removes installed binaries and shortcuts while preserving user notes by default; reinstall restores them
goldenJourneys: Fresh install -> launch -> create first note -> close -> reopen -> note remains
Create multiple notes -> favorite one -> search -> edit -> autosave -> clear search
Export notes -> reset all data -> import backup -> notes and favorites return
Switch System/Light/Dark theme -> restart -> selected preference remains
Uninstall -> reinstall -> preserved notes remain available

release.deployment: GitHub Release asset after green independent CI and installed-artifact smoke tests
release.rollback: Uninstall the current build and install the prior tested installer while preserving versioned local data; schema changes require a pre-migration backup.
